title: Extract the remaining BFF production seams from the composition root

capital.summary: Extracted PM12 semantic JSON value canonicalization (_pm12_semantic_json_value), semantic equality comparison (_pm12_semantic_values_match), and stable line assertion hashing (_pm12_allocation_line_assertion_hash) into capital.service. Eliminated implicit command_executor fallback and effective_payload overrides in write(), restoring fail-closed 503 CapitalAuthorityUnavailable on missing owner mutation method.

assistant.summary: Extracted Management AI conversation store management, persistence, access, projection handlers (get_management_ai_conversation_store, set_management_ai_conversation_store, reset_management_ai_conversation_store, management_ai_list_conversations, management_ai_get_conversation, management_ai_get_attachment, management_ai_server_conversation_context), and idempotency store/lock (get_mgmt_nl_command_idempotency_store) into assistant.management_service; removed duplicate mutable global _MGMT_NL_COMMAND_IDEMPOTENCY_STORE, eliminated reverse dependency and sys.modules lookup for main._MGMT_AI_CONVERSATION_STORE, and unified store ownership within assistant.management_service with composition injection.

agora_performance.summary: Extracted PM12 performance attribution canonical readiness, staleness, and ranking policies (performance_read_surface_state, performance_meta_staleness, performance_surface_status, performance_composed_surface_status, canonical_performance_snapshot_meta, canonical_performance_aggregate_group_surface, canonical_performance_ranking_source_surface) and sources, facts, group/page entries, metrics, data confidence, rows, and response into agora.performance.service; removed AppDependencies.create_default fallback, eliminated silent missing-source fallback and catch-all filter bypass, eliminated personas owner catch-all suppression in pm12_performance_attribution_sources, preserving full metadata parity (stale, freshness, staleness) and unavailable/degraded semantics across both direct owner and composed production paths.

personas.summary: Extracted _filter_by_common_identifiers, _extract_ids_from_item, and promotion review submission projection (_latest_promotion_review_submission, _promotion_review_submission_projection) into personas.service with explicit command_store dependency injection. In main.py: preserved owner error/503 semantics by removing catch-all empty fallback in _list_persona_records; verified failing-owner error propagation across Management AI and performance attribution composition.

command_adapters.summary: Defined stored_command_params in command_adapters.service owning operator command envelope mapping and drawer passthrough; main.py delegates directly.

governance.summary: Moved human_inbox_surface_timeout_seconds into governance.service with 1.0s hard ceiling and safe environment parsing; main.py re-exports as _human_inbox_surface_timeout_seconds.

dead_functions_gate.summary: Removed 15 orphaned wrappers in main.py, bringing the dead function count to 34 (below base commit baseline of 36).

performance_probe_unavailable.command: python3 -c 'from services.control_plane.bff.agora.performance.service import pm12_performance_attribution_response; res = pm12_performance_attribution_response(dimensions=["persona"], period="latest", page_token=None, page_size=50, read_store=object()); assert res["meta"]["surfaces"]["performance_attribution"]["status"] == "unavailable" and res["meta"]["surfaces"]["performance_attribution"]["coverage"] == 0.0 and res["meta"]["surfaces"]["performance_attribution"]["missing_bindings"] is True'
